why: the requirements sit inside collapsed accordion panels on the programme page, so a plain read of the page returns only the section headings; the page also carries a second table for applicants without a prior degree, and only the prior-degree table applies to this accelerated row
conditions: Applicants must already hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution. Minimum GPA 2.0 with grades of C or above (C- or below not acceptable). Anatomy & Physiology and Microbiology must have been taken within seven years of the start date. Pathophysiology cannot be used as a science prerequisite because it is part of the programme. Applicants take the Wonderlic Scholastic Level Exam with a minimum score of 22 on a single attempt, or otherwise a minimum 75% on the HESI A2 English Composite and Math subscales. A background check and drug screen meeting licensure requirements are required. Applicants who completed equivalent but differently titled courses may submit transcripts and course descriptions for review by the Registrar.
